angle: Its signature move is a paired outlier experiment on the same toy dataset, showing the range exploding while the interquartile range holds steady, then reading both quantities off a box-and-whisker plot of fictional ice-cream sugar data.
angle_detail: Start with [02:54]–[04:08] for the outlier-robustness demo, then use [06:52]–[08:06] to practice reading quartiles, median, and whiskers with the 25%-per-section rule. It assumes quartile computation from an earlier video and waves outlier-exclusion rules off to software, and it never touches variance or standard deviation. Watch it for robust-spread intuition and pair it with a variance source to complete the node.
